name: Omaspaces
author: Daniel Lobo
description: Configurable Hyprland workspace indicators with per-app window icons, adjustable layout, and an active-workspace style you control.

barWidget.description: Workspace indicators with per-app icons for open windows, plus layout and styling options.

schema.label: Show app icons
schema.description: Render a glyph for each open window's app inside its workspace pill.

schema.label: Show workspace numbers
schema.description: Show the workspace number (or the active-workspace marker). Turned off, an icon-only pill still falls back to numbers when app icons are also off.

schema.label: Base workspace count
schema.description: Workspaces always shown, even when empty.

schema.label: Highest workspace shown
schema.description: Workspaces above the base count are shown only up to this id, and only once they have a window.

schema.label: Hide empty extra workspaces
schema.description: Beyond the base count, drop workspaces entirely once their last window closes instead of leaving a dimmed placeholder.

schema.label: Max icons per workspace
schema.description: Caps how many app icons a single pill draws before collapsing the rest into a +N count.

schema.label: Active color
schema.description: Palette role used to tint the active-workspace highlight.

schema.label: Compact spacing
schema.description: Tighten padding and gaps between pills.

schema.label: Show window titles on hover
schema.description: Hovering a workspace pill lists the titles of its open windows.

schema.label: Custom icon rules file
schema.description: Optional path to a JSON file of [{"match": "regex", "icon": "glyph"}, ...] rules, checked before the built-in icon list. Supports ~ and $HOME. Reloads automatically when the file changes.
